title: Partner-onboarding integration harness: environment, fixture keys, terms fixture, business date, evidence and gate are not specified, the Ownership Map publishes no partner create or panel-change operation, and neither the InstructionRequest shape nor the right required to onboard is published
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Story Template and Rules v1.md §R5.5, §R7.3 and §R9; _work/msr/wp/B-ITG-W4-05.md; _work/msr/plan/ownership.json; 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md RWB-E6-029 lines 11820-11899
description: RWB-ITG-E6029-ITG needs four things no source gives. (a) The SIT environment and base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic partner and contract keys, the terms fixture that carries the fee schedule version, the service levels and the scope, the business date, the evidence format and its retention, and the pass or fail gate at the wave entry check. (b) The Ownership Map publishes GET /partners and GET /partner/instructions but no partner create and no panel-change operation, so the onboarding write cannot be driven through a published operation: it is RWB-S9-E6029-APP's own path and is observed here only through the published read, DP08 and the decision log, and the harness must never compose a partner endpoint. (c) The InstructionRequest body of POST /cases/{caseId}/instructions is named in TSD S9 appendix T-A but not shaped anywhere in the extracted sources, and no source states which capability-area right the onboarding itself needs; the TSD RBAC matrix gives every listed role at least Partner portal R, so AC6 is proved on a negative session fixture rather than on a role that lacks the right. One placeholder is therefore used in sections 3, 12.2, 12.8, 13 and 15.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E6-029 (User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3, lines 11820-11899) names the two partner reads, the partner, decision_log_entry and rule_row entities with their DF ranges, SCR-34 and SCR-35, one permission-check row and TC-E6-029-01 to TC-E6-029-04, and states no environment, fixture, key scheme, terms fixture, business date, evidence format or gate; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 line 134 (FEAT-PRM-01, prerequisite FEAT-OCC-13) and Business Requirements Program v4 lines 430, 431 and 437 (REQ-S9-001, REQ-S9-002, REQ-S9-008) give the outcome and no harness detail; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 lines 361, 362, 429, 430, 431, 433 and 449 (R-WO-30, R-WO-31, R-UNI-25, R-UNI-26, R-UNI-27, R-UNI-29, R-UNI-45) give the placement and recall rules and no harness configuration; FSD S9 Partner management v3 lines 89-170 gives the step table, VR-S9-001-1, BR-S9-001, the field catalogue, the two roles and AC-EXC-S9-001-01 and AC-EXC-S9-001-02, and names no onboarding operation; TSD S9 Partner management v2 lines 197-277 lists API-S9-001 to API-S9-006 and names InstructionRequest as the request body of API-S9-002 without defining it, and lines 130-165 gives Partner portal R to RW-CASEOWN and every other listed role; ownership.json holds S9 for GET /partners, POST /cases/{caseId}/instructions and GET /partner/instructions, P1 for GET /data-products/{productCode}/records, P3 for GET /cases/{caseId}, P7 for GET /decision-log and P4 for GET /me/session, and holds no partner create or panel-change operation; Arch v5 lines 1245-1256 and 1270-1272, line 2891 and slide 43 rows 20 and 21 (lines 2946 and 2947) give the contract, the schema and the events and no harness artefact; Temporal and Drools Design v1 slide 25 lines 1663-1755 gives step 1 and the clocks and no harness; Template and Rules v1 §R7.3 lists the fill order and none of its sources holds these values.
area: Integration harness configuration and contract coverage
proposed: Agree at the wave 4 entry check the SIT base hosts, the fixture layout and the synthetic partner and contract key scheme, the terms fixture with its fee schedule version, service levels and scope, the business date, the evidence format and retention and the pass or fail gate, and record them in the harness README; publish the InstructionRequest shape in RWB-S9-E6029-CON and state the capability-area right the onboarding needs, or confirm that the onboarding is proved through the published reads with a negative session fixture for the refusal; the fixture values stay data and no business value is hard-coded.
